description: Auto-merge duplicate CANDIDATE entities in a campaign that share the same normalized name and type, keeping the best-evidenced one. Never touches TRACKED or pinned entities - merge those explicitly with chargen_merge_entities. It also returns merge_suggestions: an NPC record and a Monster record with the same name (often one villain who was talked to in one session and fought in the next). These are NOT merged. To merge one, ask the DM which record to keep and call chargen_merge_entities with that record as target_entity_id; the target keeps its type and the merge can be undone. This connector cannot dismiss a suggestion: the DM keeps the two records separate on the web Review page, and until then the pair is listed again.
name: chargen_dedupe_candidates
title: Merge duplicate candidates
